description: This file defines the internal class SQSBatchContainer, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for handling batches of SQS messages within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes serialization, deserialization, and utility methods for working with SQS messages and stream events.

classes.name: SQSBatchContainer
classes.description: An internal class representing a batch of SQS messages for Orleans streaming, supporting serialization, deserialization, and event retrieval.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specified type from the batch, associating each with a sequence token.

methods.name: ToSQSMessage
methods.description: Serializes a batch of events into an SQS SendMessageRequest with a JSON payload.

methods.name: FromSQSMessage
methods.description: Deserializes an SQS message into an SQSBatchContainer, reconstructing the batch and sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context stored within the batch into the current execution context.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the batch container, including stream ID and item count.
